blocks.body:
name = "climatehealth-${var.environment}-${var.name_suffix}"
  tags = { Project = "ClimateHealth", Environment = var.environment, ManagedBy = "Terraform" }

source = "./modules/mysql"
  name = local.name
  subnet_ids = module.networking.private_subnet_ids
  security_group = module.networking.mysql_sg
  availability_zone = module.networking.availability_zone

source = "./modules/frontend"
  name = local.name
  api_enabled = var.deploy_application
  origin_hostname = var.deploy_application ? trimsuffix(aws_route53_record.origin[0].fqdn, ".") : null
  origin_header = var.origin_verification_header

count = var.deploy_application ? 1 : 0
  source = "./modules/alb"
  vpc_id = module.networking.vpc_id
  subnet_ids = module.networking.public_subnet_ids
  security_group = module.networking.alb_sg
  certificate_arn = var.origin_certificate_arn
  origin_header = var.origin_verification_header

count = var.deploy_application ? 1 : 0
  source = "./modules/ecs-backend"
  name = local.name
  region = var.aws_region
  tags = local.tags
  permissions_boundary_arn = var.permissions_boundary_arn
  ami_id = var.ecs_ami_id
  subnet_id = module.networking.public_subnet_ids[0]
  security_group = module.networking.backend_sg
  target_group_arn = module.alb[0].target_group_arn
  listener_rule_arn = module.alb[0].listener_rule_arn
  image = var.backend_image
  desired_count = var.backend_desired_count
  max_instances = var.backend_max_instances
  repository_arn = module.ecr.arns["${local.name}-backend"]
  secret_arns = var.runtime_secret_arns
  db_host = module.database.host
  log_group_name = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.backend.name
  log_group_arn = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.backend.arn

name_prefix = "ch-"
  load_balancer_type         = "application"
  security_groups            = [var.security_group]
  subnets = var.subnet_ids
  internal                   = false
  desync_mitigation_mode     = "strictest"
  drop_invalid_header_fields = true

name_prefix = "ch-"
  port = 8080
  protocol = "HTTP"
  target_type = "instance"
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  deregistration_delay = 30
  health_check {
    enabled = true
    protocol = "HTTP"
    healthy_threshold = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    timeout = 5
    interval = 30
    matcher = "200"
    path = "/health/ready"
  }

for_each = aws_ecr_repository.ecr
  repository = each.value.name
  policy = jsonencode({ rules = [{ rulePriority = 1, description = "Remove untagged layers after rollback window", selection = { tagStatus = "untagged", countType = "sinceImagePushed", countUnit = "days", countNumber = 14 }, action = { type = "expire" } }] })

role = aws_iam_role.execution.id
  policy = jsonencode({ Version = "2012-10-17", Statement = [
        { Effect = "Allow", Action = "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken", Resource = "*" },
        { Effect = "Allow", Action = ["ecr:BatchGetImage","ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer","ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"], Resource = [var.repository_arn] },
        { Effect = "Allow", Action = ["logs:CreateLogStream","logs:PutLogEvents"], Resource = "${var.log_group_arn}:*" },
        { Effect = "Allow", Action = ["ssm:GetParameters"], Resource = values(var.secret_arns) }
      ] })

blocks.body:
family = "${var.name}-backend"
  requires_compatibilities = ["EC2"]
  network_mode = "bridge"
  execution_role_arn = aws_iam_role.execution.arn
  container_definitions = jsonencode([{
        name = "backend", image = var.image, essential = true,
        memory = 1024, cpu = 256, stopTimeout = 60, readonlyRootFilesystem = true,
        portMappings = [{ containerPort = 8000, hostPort = 8080, protocol = "tcp" }],
        linuxParameters = { tmpfs = [{ containerPath = "/tmp", size = 128, mountOptions = ["rw","nosuid"] }] },
        command = ["gunicorn","--bind","0.0.0.0:8000","--workers","1","--threads","1","--timeout","30","--graceful-timeout","25","climat:app"],
        environment = [
          {name="DB_HOST",value=var.db_host}, {name="DB_NAME",value="climate_db"},
          {name="DATABASE_WRITES_ENABLED",value="false"}, {name="CLIMATE_ENV",value="aws"},
          {name="DB_TLS_MODE",value="verify_identity"},
          {name="DB_TLS_CA_FILE",value="/app/infrastructure/certificates/rds-us-east-1-bundle.crt"}
        ],
        secrets = [for k,v in var.secret_arns : { name=k, valueFrom=v }],
        logConfiguration = { logDriver="awslogs", options={"awslogs-group"=var.log_group_name,"awslogs-region"=var.region,"awslogs-stream-prefix"="backend"} },
        healthCheck = { command=["CMD","python","-c","import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health/live',timeout=3)"],interval=30,timeout=5,retries=3,startPeriod=60 }
  }])

blocks.body:
identifier = var.name
  engine = "mysql"
  engine_version = "8.4.13"
  engine_lifecycle_support = "open-source-rds-extended-support-disabled"
  instance_class = "db.t4g.micro"
  allocated_storage = 20
  max_allocated_storage = 20
  storage_type = "gp3"
  storage_encrypted = true
  username = "climate_admin"
  manage_master_user_password = true
  db_name = "climate_db"
  port = 3306
  availability_zone = var.availability_zone
  multi_az = false
  publicly_accessible = false
  db_subnet_group_name = aws_db_subnet_group.this.name
  parameter_group_name = aws_db_parameter_group.this.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [var.security_group]
  backup_retention_period = 7
  deletion_protection = true
  lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }
  skip_final_snapshot = false
  final_snapshot_identifier = "${var.name}-final"
  copy_tags_to_snapshot = true

cidr_block           = var.vpc_cidr
  instance_tenancy     = "default"
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
  enable_dns_support   = true
  tags                 = {
    Name = var.name
  }

count = 2
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.this.id
  cidr_block = cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, 8, count.index)
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false
  availability_zone = local.zones[count.index]
  tags                    = {
    Name = "${var.name}-public-${count.index}"
  }

count = 2
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.this.id
  cidr_block = cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, 8, 10 + count.index)
  availability_zone = local.zones[count.index]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false
  tags                    = {
    Name = "${var.name}-private-${count.index}"
  }

vpc_id = aws_vpc.this.id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.${data.aws_region.current.region}.s3"
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Gateway"
  route_table_ids = [aws_route_table.public.id, aws_route_table.private.id]

security_group_id = aws_security_group.alb.id
  prefix_list_id = data.aws_ec2_managed_prefix_list.cloudfront.id
  ip_protocol = "tcp"
  from_port = 443
  to_port = 443

security_group_id = aws_security_group.backend.id
  referenced_security_group_id = aws_security_group.alb.id
  ip_protocol = "tcp"
  from_port = 8080
  to_port = 8080

security_group_id = aws_security_group.alb.id
  referenced_security_group_id = aws_security_group.backend.id
  ip_protocol = "tcp"
  from_port = 8080
  to_port = 8080

security_group_id = aws_security_group.mysql.id
  referenced_security_group_id = aws_security_group.backend.id
  ip_protocol = "tcp"
  from_port = 3306
  to_port = 3306

security_group_id = aws_security_group.backend.id
  referenced_security_group_id = aws_security_group.mysql.id
  ip_protocol = "tcp"
  from_port = 3306
  to_port = 3306

security_group_id = aws_security_group.backend.id
  cidr_ipv4 = "0.0.0.0/0"
  ip_protocol = "tcp"
  from_port = 443
  to_port = 443

    error_message = "Only the reviewed us-east-1 configuration is supported."

  default = "10.42.0.0/16"
  description = "A /16 IPv4 VPC; four non-overlapping /24 subnets are derived."
  validation {
    condition = can(cidrnetmask(var.vpc_cidr)) && try(tonumber(split("/", var.vpc_cidr)[1]) == 16, false)
    error_message = "Provide a reviewed IPv4 /16 CIDR."
  }

blocks.body:
type = number
  default = 0
  description = "Bootstrap at zero; request one task only after CP association is ready."
  validation {
    condition = contains([0, 1], var.backend_desired_count) && (var.deploy_application || var.backend_desired_count == 0)
    error_message = "Use 0 or 1; keep zero while deploy_application is false."
  }

attributes.name: description
attributes.expression: "Bootstrap at zero; request one task only after CP association is ready."

blocks.body:
type = number
  default = 1
  description = "Upper ASG capacity; two is an explicitly approved temporary rolling budget."
  validation {
    condition = contains([1, 2], var.backend_max_instances)
    error_message = "Allow one host normally or two for a reviewed rolling deployment."
  }

attributes.name: description
attributes.expression: "Upper ASG capacity; two is an explicitly approved temporary rolling budget."

blocks.body:
type = string
  default = null
  description = "Reviewed digest in this environment's backend ECR repository; CI supplies the digest."
  validation {
    condition = var.backend_image == null ? !var.deploy_application : (can(regex("@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$", var.backend_image)) && startswith(var.backend_image, "${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}.dkr.ecr.${var.aws_region}.amazonaws.com/climatehealth-${var.environment}-${var.name_suffix}-backend@sha256:"))
    error_message = "Use an immutable digest from the selected account/region/environment backend ECR repository."
  }

attributes.name: description
attributes.expression: "Reviewed digest in this environment's backend ECR repository; CI supplies the digest."

blocks.body:
type = string
  default = null
  description = "Approved AL2023 ECS-optimized x86_64 AMI; replacement/refresh needs review."
  validation {
    condition = var.ecs_ami_id == null ? !var.deploy_application : can(regex("^ami-([0-9a-f]{8}|[0-9a-f]{17})$", var.ecs_ami_id))
    error_message = "An approved ECS AMI is required for the application. Syntax does not verify its contents."
  }

attributes.name: description
attributes.expression: "Approved AL2023 ECS-optimized x86_64 AMI; replacement/refresh needs review."

blocks.body:
type = string
  default = null
  description = "Existing DNS hostname covered by the ALB origin certificate."
  validation {
    condition = var.origin_hostname == null ? !var.deploy_application : (length(var.origin_hostname) <= 253 && can(regex("^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\\.)+[a-z]{2,63}$", var.origin_hostname)))
    error_message = "Provide a valid approved lowercase DNS hostname without scheme/path/trailing dot."
  }

attributes.name: description
attributes.expression: "Existing DNS hostname covered by the ALB origin certificate."

blocks.body:
type = string
  default = null
  description = "Existing approved Route53 hosted zone; this root does not buy a domain."
  validation {
    condition = var.origin_zone_id == null ? !var.deploy_application : can(regex("^Z[A-Z0-9]+$", var.origin_zone_id))
    error_message = "An existing Route53 zone ID is required for the application."
  }

attributes.name: description
attributes.expression: "Existing approved Route53 hosted zone; this root does not buy a domain."

blocks.body:
type = string
  default = null
  description = "Issued ALB ACM certificate ARN with correct DNS SAN/account/region."
  validation {
    condition = var.origin_certificate_arn == null ? !var.deploy_application : (can(regex("^arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:[0-9]{12}:certificate/[0-9a-f-]+$", var.origin_certificate_arn)) && try(split(":", var.origin_certificate_arn)[4] == data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id, false))
    error_message = "Provide an ACM certificate ARN in the selected account and region; issuance/SAN need review."
  }

attributes.name: description
attributes.expression: "Issued ALB ACM certificate ARN with correct DNS SAN/account/region."

blocks.body:
type = string
  default = null
  sensitive = true
  description = "Generate a fresh random URL-safe origin value; never print or commit it."
  validation {
    condition = var.origin_verification_header == null ? !var.deploy_application : can(regex("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,128}$", var.origin_verification_header))
    error_message = "Use 32-128 random URL-safe letters/digits/underscore/hyphen, without wildcards or whitespace."
  }

attributes.expression: "Generate a fresh random URL-safe origin value; never print or commit it."

attributes.name: description

blocks.body:
type = string
  default = null
  description = "Existing reviewed IAM boundary for application roles; does not change HCP authentication."
  validation {
    condition = var.permissions_boundary_arn == null ? !var.deploy_application : (startswith(var.permissions_boundary_arn, "arn:aws:iam::${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}:policy/") && try(length(split("policy/", var.permissions_boundary_arn)[1]) > 0, false))
    error_message = "Application IAM roles require an existing reviewed boundary in the selected account."
  }
